title: Pink rock found in Sahara turns out to be 4.1-billion-year-old Martian meteorite, reveals clues to ancient Mars
description: A meteorite named Teghaza 001, discovered in the Sahara Desert, reveals insights into ancient Martian geology. Scientists determined it originated on Mars over 4.1 billion years ago and underwent volcanic processes. Detailed analysis of zircon crystals indicated interactions with water, suggesting a more active early environment. Researchers identified potential geological…

title: This fossil may look like a mini T. rex, but a Nanotyrannus just sold for a giant $47 million
description: By PHILIP MARCELO NEW YORK (AP) — A dinosaur that looks like a miniature T. rex is now one of the world’s most expensive fossils.
